maria-partnerships: Quick sync: planning a "BrightPath" observability quickstart for Redwood Private customers. Goal: on-prem OTEL collector + Datadog dashboard bundle + runbook. Lab window proposed May 16-20. Owners: Alex (dashboards/runbook), Raj (collector/deploy), Sam (quickstart repo), Kim (Datadog support). Anyone object?

alex-observability: No objections. I'll draft dashboard JSON and a trimmed set of widgets: trace latency heatmap, per-model span counts, and GPU utilization vs span rate. Need a sample trace generator.

raj-eng-sre: I'll produce two collector configs: (A) file exporter for fully air-gapped installs and (B) proxy-forwarder for customers that permit egress. Quick example for A below for review.

raj-eng-sre: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
exporters:
  file:
    path: /var/log/otel/records.json
processors:
  batch: {}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [file]
```

sam-devex: I'll scaffold a docker-compose lab and a tiny trace-generator (node/python). Add `make demo` to run and output the file so Alex can import into Datadog import helper.

kim-datadog-partner: Datadog can supply sample dashboard JSON and a helper script to ingest the file when customers choose to attach our intake. We'll also provide guidance on API key/scoped tokens.

maria-partnerships: Security ask: add attribute redaction example and KMS guidance for storing any keys. Raj please add a brief HSM note.

raj-eng-sre: Will add an attributes processor snippet for redaction and a KMS/HSM section (AWS KMS, Vault, KMIP note). Example redaction:

```yaml
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: user.email
        action: delete
```

ops-bot: Action created: BP-OBS-2026 assigned to raj-eng-sre, alex-observability, sam-devex, kim-datadog-partner. Due: 2026-05-14.

maria-partnerships: Deliverables checklist - runbook, collector configs, quickstart repo, Datadog dashboard + ingestion helper, security guidance. Reply with :thumbsup: to accept.

alex-observability: :thumbsup: first draft by EOW.

raj-eng-sre: :thumbsup: pushing collector examples to repos/partner/brightpath/otel-onprem.

sam-devex: :thumbsup: I'll add CI to run the lab on PRs.

kim-datadog-partner: :thumbsup: will share dashboard JSON and test scripts.

maria-partnerships: Thanks. Next sync Wed 10am PT. Marking this thread as coordination hub. :rocket:
